channel.title: Alabama Political Reporter - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Alabama Political Reporter (alreporter.com)

item.title: Sen. Britt secures over $111.3M for Alabama in fiscal funding
item.description: Senator Katie Britt, R-Ala., secured more than $200.7 million for the state after voting last week to pass a key package of FY26 appropriations bills.

item.title: Rep. Robertson files bill allowing judges to deny bail to illegal immigrants
item.description: Citing instances of attempted murder and double homicides by undocumented immigrants, state legislators introduced a bill to deny bail for those charged with violent crimes.

item.title: Gov. Ivey appoints Chris Connolly as circuit judge in Lauderdale County
item.description: Gov. Kay Ivey appointed Christopher E. Connolly circuit judge in Lauderdale County, praising his 20 years as district attorney and legal experience.

item.title: Gov. Ivey concludes School Choice Week, introduces the Davis family
item.description: Gov. Kay Ivey concluded School Choice Week by spotlighting the Davis family, who found homeschooling flexibility and expanded educational opportunities using the CHOOSE Act.

item.title: Opinion | HB72 goes too far in the name of child protection
item.description: Community leader Antoinette King strongly opposed HB 72, arguing the legislation risked criminalizing parents and unfairly targeted families needing support, not state intervention.

item.title: Alabama 2026 Legislative Report: Week Three
item.description: Lawmakers advanced legislation in both chambers as committees continued work and new bills were introduced during the third week.

item.title: This week on The V: Tuberville’s Residency risks, Trump muscle, and old Mo returns
item.description: Tuberville faces court threats, Trump reshapes the GOP ticket, and Mo Brooks resurfaces as Democrats quietly rebuild statewide.

item.title: ALGOP clears Wahl, Tuberville, Gudger, Odle removed as ballot challenges narrowed
item.description: Party committees dismiss residency challenges against top candidates while advancing two cases and removing one contender from ballot.

item.title: Meet the 22-year-old University of Alabama student running for state house
item.description: Running for House District 16, Christian Martin would be one of the youngest state lawmakers in Alabama history if elected.

item.title: Opinion | Protest songs mark when legality fails and conscience demands change
item.description: From Springsteen to Lamar, protest songs expose when legality shields injustice and force moral reckonings politics tries to delay.
